templates.source: ACTi 'Viewing video stream using VLC player' (download.acti.com/?id=29560): 'Command: rtsp://IPaddress:RTSPport/stream#' with example rtsp://172.16.26.14:4014/stream1. Corroborated by ACTi Camera Firmware Manual A713/A950/A951/Q450 (download.acti.com/?id=28964): RTSP format is rtsp://<ip address>:<rtsp port>/<access name>, default RTSP port 554.

ACTi 'Viewing video stream using VLC player' (download.acti.com/?id=29560): 'Command: rtsp://IPaddress:RTSPport/stream#' — stream number is 1-based index; Stream 2 documented as sub-stream in ACTi Camera Firmware Manual A713/A950/A951/Q450 (download.acti.com/?id=28964).

https://www2.acti.com/support_old/Package/%7BFCCD9EA1-3AA7-4C31-8F94-B17BCDAA67E.PDF — ACTi Support Package TS-00110 (How to test RTP protocol with ACTi devices, updated 2007-08-14): legacy MPEG-4 devices (ACM/TCM/KCM/CAM lines) are opened in VLC with the bare MRL rtsp://<IP Address>:7070 (with auth after firmware v2.04: rtsp://Admin:123456@192.168.1.107:7070), i.e. root path on legacy default RTSP port 7070.

notes: ACTi cameras expose RTSP streams at /stream<N> (1-based: /stream1 = main, /stream2 = sub, up to /stream4 on some models). The RTSP access name is user-configurable in the camera web UI (Streaming > RTSP > Access Name); /stream1 is the typical factory default observed in ACTi's own VLC guide. Default RTSP port is 554 per the current firmware manual. Port 7070 is the legacy (MPEG-4-era) default RTSP port. Cameras supporting up to 4 streams use /stream1–/stream4. ACTi is a Taiwanese manufacturer (acti.com), not an OEM of Dahua or Hikvision. Legacy MPEG-4-era ACTi devices (ACM-/TCM-/KCM- series) serve RTSP at the root path on default RTSP port 7070 per ACTi Support Package TS-00110 (rtsp://<ip>:7070), so the "/" main template applies to those lines; current models use /stream<N> on port 554.
